# IAL2-FEATURE-COMPLETENESS-FRONTIER: IAL2 Feature Completeness Frontier

## Metadata

- Tree ID: `IAL2-FEATURE-COMPLETENESS-FRONTIER`
- Status: `active`
- Roadmap lane: `IAL2 / SV-backed feature completeness`
- Created: `2026-06-12`
- Last updated: `2026-06-25`
- Owner: repo-local workflow

## Goal

Drive IAL2 toward feature completeness on the SystemVerilog-backed lowering
path before reopening VHDL backend or VHDL rerouting work.

## Non-Goals

- Do not implement VHDL backend or VHDL reroute work from this tree.
- Do not claim IAL2 is feature complete until all selected protocol/platform
  intent surfaces, diagnostics, generated IAL1/IAL0 review artifacts, HDL
  generation, reports, and mdBook documentation are task-tree owned and
  verified.
- Do not bypass the required `IAL2 -> IAL1 -> IAL0 -> SystemVerilog` lowering
  chain.
- Do not widen `.isf` with IAL2 source forms by accident; any IAL1 feature
  required by IAL2 must be explicitly selected, task-tree owned, documented,
  and regression-backed.
- Do not describe IAL0, IAL1, IAL2, or the mdBook as Perl-only APIs. They are
  backend-language-neutral contracts for the current Perl reference
  implementation plus future Rust, Rust/Wasm, browser-capable JavaScript, and
  Dart/web implementations; see `docs/decisions/0018`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- The first leaf audits shipped IAL2 surfaces and selects the next exact
  feature-completeness slice before behavior changes.
- The audit explicitly records any IAL1 or IAL0/SV prerequisites required by
  the selected IAL2 slice.
- Every implementation leaf preserves reviewable generated IAL1 and IAL0
  artifacts before SystemVerilog HDL generation.
- Public contracts, diagnostics, mdBook, roadmap, and Knowledge Map are kept in
  sync for each shipped IAL2 capability.
- Each completed leaf is committed through `COMMIT.md`.

## Decisions

- `2026-06-25`: `.475` selected `.476`, readiness audit for
  identity-preserving same-transaction queue recapture ID refresh. It does not
  select a positive same-cycle queue recapture report field yet. Existing
  queue reports keep `generated_update_rules` as literal emitted-rule lists
  under `same_id_ordering.dynamic_id_reuse_policy.*.generated_queues[]`.
  Classic `same_cycle_release_recapture_policy` and `release_recapture_*`
  fields remain exclusive to dynamic response-demux capture state. The
  selector found the current dynamic queue transition report contains
  same-cycle dequeue-plus-enqueue rules such as
  `r0_dequeue_enqueue_r1` and `r0_r1_dequeue_enqueue_r0`, but not one-entry
  identity-preserving rules such as `r0_dequeue_enqueue_r0` or
  `w0_dequeue_enqueue_w0`; `.476` must decide whether to add state-key-
  preserving slot-ID refresh rules, document/fail-close that case, split the
  owner, or defer. Broader queues, mixed dynamic/static queues, scoreboards,
  direct backend behavior, backend-language variants, and VHDL remain future
  exact owners.

  aliases remain future exact-owner work.

## Changelog

- `2026-06-25`: Completed `.475`, report/static contract selection for
  generated dynamic same-ID `issue-order-queue` same-cycle recapture. It
  selected `.476`, identity-preserving same-transaction queue recapture
  ID-refresh readiness, instead of adding a positive recapture report field.
  Current queue reports keep `generated_update_rules` as literal emitted-rule
  lists under `same_id_ordering.dynamic_id_reuse_policy.*.generated_queues[]`.
  Classic `same_cycle_release_recapture_policy` and `release_recapture_*`
  fields remain exclusive to dynamic response-demux capture state. The
  selector found current reports include `*_dequeue_enqueue_*` rules, but not
  one-entry same-transaction ID-refresh rules such as `r0_dequeue_enqueue_r0`
  or `w0_dequeue_enqueue_w0`; `.476` owns that audit before behavior or report
  keys change.
- `2026-06-25`: Completed `.474`, queue recapture readiness after generated
  dynamic read same-ID `issue-order-queue` multi-beat output banks. The audit
  selected `.475`, public report/static contract selection for queue-owned
  same-cycle selected-dequeue-plus-enqueue recapture. It found emitted
  `*_dequeue_enqueue_*` queue rules and no classic release-recapture queue
  report fields; `.475` subsequently narrowed those rule names to literal
  generated-rule evidence and routed identity-preserving one-entry ID refresh
  to `.476`. No parser, generator, PPIF sample, support-accounting catalog,
  validation behavior, generated artifact, test, JSON, HDL, runtime behavior,
  direct backend behavior, backend-language variant, queue behavior,
  scoreboard, or VHDL behavior changed.
- `2026-06-25`: Completed `.473`, generated multi-beat output banks over
  dynamic read same-ID `issue-order-queue` runtime-validation read-data. It
  adds the support-accounted public sample
